Mantei, F., Ali, R.E., Baensch, C., Voelker, S., Haltenort, P., Burger, J., Dietrich, R.-U., von der Assen, N., Schaadt, A., Sauer, J. and Salem, O. (2021). Techno-economic assessment and carbon footprint of processes for the large-scale production of oxymethylene dimethyl ethers from carbon dioxide and hydrogen. Sustainable Energy & Fuels, accepted manuscript published online 15 November 2021. DOI: 10.1039/D1SE01270C. (File name N-644458.pdf is the RSC manuscript number.)

Page numbers are the manuscript page numbers printed as Page N of 20 (PDF page = N + 1 because of the cover page). Aspen Plus simulations of four OME3-5 routes (P1-P4) from H2 and CO2, 100 kt/a, German chemical park, base year 2018, 8000 h/a, 20 years, H2 4241 EUR/t and CO2 309 EUR/t. Loaded per route: TRL range, capacity, capex (FCI per t/a, derived), opex-variable and opex-total per t (derived from Mio EUR/a), net production cost (EUR/lDE), three efficiencies (energy, carbon, mass as targets), H2 and electricity SEC (kWh/kWh product LHV), and flows (steam, heat above 250 degC, H2, CO2, N2, air). Not loaded: the Supplementary Information (ESI, not in file), cost breakdown figures (chart-only), carbon-footprint figures except two text values (other-values). Traps: (1) Table 4 gives energy per kWh of product LHV and negative values mean surplus; P4 steam 4 bar +0.24 and 20 bar -0.07 versus P3 +0.09 and +0.16 as read from the layout; (2) the Table 8 TRL of the total process (P1 3-7, P2 3-5, P3 3-8, P4 3-6) is a mean-based assignment and the order is as printed; (3) the P4 OPEX components (labour 5.9, direct 6.2, indirect 9.0) do not sum with R&U 179 to the printed total 197; printed totals used; (4) CO2 base cost 309 EUR/t is high (capture-source dependent) and drives opex; (5) the manuscript is an accepted version with placeholder numbering (Received 00th January 20xx).
